why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. Item 1: the builder brief says "Do NOT catch the error and return `{}` or the defaults" and "`loadConfig` must keep throwing." The try/catch it asks for around `JSON.parse` exists only to "throw a new error" that includes the path and the location, so it never returns a value. Item 2: verifier Check 2 accepts the location "in any readable form (e.g. `line 3 column 3`, `3:3`, `line 3, col 3`)". It fails a run only if `bad config:` is missing, the path is missing or altered, or the line or column shown is not 3. It doesn't require one exact format or order. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
